before.review_notes:
Giant Text displays typed text at the largest size that fits the screen.

How to use it:
• iPhone/iPad — tap once to edit, type, then tap Done. Two-finger tap opens Options.
• Mac — click to edit; right-click (or Control-click) opens Options.
• Apple TV — Play/Pause edits text; the Menu button opens Options.

On iPhone the device intentionally stays in portrait while the text renders sideways, so the long edge of the screen can be used for the largest possible letters. This is the app's core feature, not a layout bug.

The app requires no account and makes no network requests.

after.description:
Turn your screen into a large, readable sign. Type a message, finish editing, and Giant Text scales the letters to fit the display.

Choose serif or sans-serif text, bold or italic, adjustable letter spacing, and up to five lines. Pick from 20 color themes with light and dark variants, or let the app choose a daily theme. Optional Bloom, Jitter and Ripple animations add movement; Reduce Motion keeps the text still.

Use it for a meeting point, a quick reminder, or a message across a noisy room. Your current text and preferences are saved on the device. No developer account, advertising or purchase is required.

description.before:
Plan your route through the maze, enter your moves, and watch the round play out.

Play solo or share one device with up to four players. Choose from eight maze difficulties and five game modes, including cheese-and-exit challenges and timed rounds. Change your animal character, compare scores, and revisit completed matches in local history.

description.after:
Plan your route through the maze, enter your moves, and watch the round play out.

Play solo or share one device with up to four players. Choose from eight maze difficulties and five game modes, including cheese-and-exit challenges and timed rounds. Choose an animal character, explore the optional Animal Adventure theme, compare scores, and revisit completed matches in local history.

Match history and preferences stay on your device. No account or internet connection is required for gameplay.

review_notes.before: Review instructions for prepared version 1.0 build 2: no account, sign-in or purchase is required. Gameplay works without an internet connection. Choose player seats, maze difficulty and game mode, then start a game. Enter a sequence of directional moves and submit it to see the route and round result. Up to four people can share one device. Complete a match, then use History to review locally saved results. The theme selector switches between Mouse and Spider appearances. Preferences and match history are stored locally. Privacy and support controls open external web pages. No reviewer credentials are needed.
review_notes.after:
Mouse Out 1.0 (3) is a local maze and route-planning game. No account, purchase, server or network connection is required for gameplay.

Start a game, join one to four players on the same device, choose a mode, enter a sequence of directional moves and submit it. Compare the resulting routes and scores. Complete a match and reopen History after relaunching. History stays on this device; save errors are shown instead of silently discarding the result.

The optional Animal Adventure theme uses original animal artwork reused from Fendoku with the owner's permission. On the launch screen, tap the upper center area five times within 2.2 seconds to switch themes. This preserves the same modes, player seats, movement rules, objectives and scoring. Player choices use animal names, and the reference runner is a mouse. The owner has confirmed that the bundled music and sound effects are their own work.

The Help menu opens the privacy policy at https://nathanfennel.com/mouse-out/privacy.html and the developer's contact page.

Open an element to learn its atomic number, atomic mass, physical properties, common uses, history, and naming origins. Browse photos and diagrams with source and license credits, and follow Wikipedia references for further reading.

new_platform_drafts_2026_09_28.description:
TidyTasker keeps your daily tasks organized on iPhone and iPad. Capture tasks quickly, edit names and notes, choose due dates, and group your list by when work is due. Reorder tasks, mark them complete, and review their edit history.

Make the list your own with color themes and typography choices. Optional starter prompts help you begin. Your tasks can sync through your private iCloud account.

With your permission, import Apple Reminders due today and keep linked completion states in sync. No separate TidyTasker account is required.
new_platform_drafts_2026_09_28.review_notes:
Version 1.1 for iPhone and iPad. No separate app account, sign-in, paid unlock or subscription is required. Create a task, edit its name/content and due date, reorder it, toggle completion and open its history. Settings provides theme and typography choices and links to support and the privacy policy.

Optional Reminders access imports due-today reminders and updates linked completion states; access may be declined. Release storage uses the app group and private CloudKit. Optional Home Screen widgets and Live Activities belong to the iOS target; Live Activities depend on device support and the Settings choice. No reviewer credentials are required.

metadata.description:
Give each day, week and month a clear intention. Write a short focus, choose its look, and return to it throughout your day.

Start with your own words or use the step-by-step guide. Browse and search saved intentions, adjust colors and fonts, and keep your current focus visible in a Home Screen widget. Optional reminders help you return to your intentions.

Optional AI features can suggest intentions or a visual theme. Before you use them, Attunetion explains what is sent through its service to OpenAI and asks for your consent. You can stop future AI sharing in Settings and continue writing manually.

Your saved intentions and preferences stay on this device in this release. No app account is required. Internet access is needed for AI features; manual writing works without it.
metadata.subtitle: Set your daily intention
metadata.review_notes:
No demo account or sign-in is required. These instructions cover the prepared 1.0 build 3.

Onboarding can create an intention or be skipped with an empty entry. The + button creates a day, week or month intention. The guide offers editable examples and optional AI suggestions. AI requires explicit consent and internet access. Manual writing and styling remain available after declining consent.

Settings > Suggested Intentions > Stop Sharing with AI stops future AI calls. Settings > Delete Local Data removes local records, custom themes, widget data and reminders. It does not recall data previously sent to providers. This release uses device-local storage and does not claim active iCloud sync.

Version 2.0 (build 5).

No sign-in, network connection, or in-app purchase is required. Choose player names, human/computer control, board size, and Classic or Plus. Start game and choose a highlighted number on each turn.
